# JuaneloJGAC Tech

> AI consulting agency helping startups and SMEs build smarter products, automations, and AI experiences.

## About

JuaneloJGAC Tech is an AI consulting and development agency founded by Juan Almeida. We specialize in practical, intelligent AI solutions for startups and small-to-medium businesses (SMEs). We serve clients across the United States and Latin America, with offices in Milton, Florida and Quito, Ecuador.

We are fully bilingual (English and Spanish) and deliver projects in 4–12 weeks.

## Services

### AI Automations Platform
- Eliminate repetitive workflows with intelligent automation solutions
- Custom AI-powered automations designed for startups and SMEs
- Price range: $3,000–$10,000 USD

### AI Marketing Studio
- AI-driven content creation and marketing automation
- Intelligent content generation and campaign optimization
- Price range: $3,000–$10,000 USD

### AI-Powered Web Development
- Fast, modern web platforms built with AI assistance
- Custom e-commerce, dashboards, and web applications
- Price range: $3,000–$10,000 USD

### AI Consultancy & Digital Transformation
- Strategic AI consulting to transform business processes
- Expert guidance on AI implementation and automation strategy
- Digital transformation roadmaps
- Price range: $3,000–$10,000 USD

## Target Audience

- Startups looking to integrate AI into their products and workflows
- Small and medium businesses (SMEs) seeking digital transformation
- Companies in the US and Latin America needing bilingual AI consulting
